meta.name: improve-codebase-architecture
meta.description: Scan a codebase for deepening opportunities, present them as a visual HTML report, then grill through whichever one you pick.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描代码库发现架构优化机会,生成可视化报告并深入剖析
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你负责维护日渐庞杂的代码库,想找到架构改进的发力点
copy.tagline_en: Scan your codebase for architecture improvements, then dive into each one
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to systematically uncover architecture improvement areas in your codebase

howto.what: 扫描代码库，找出“浅层”模块并提出改造成“深层”模块的机会（目标是更易测试、更易让AI理解），生成带前后对比图的HTML报告，再和你一起仔细探讨你选中的方案，过程中同步更新领域术语记录。
howto.when: 当你说“分析代码库架构”“找出重构机会”等，或点名一个模块/子系统/痛点时，Claude 会启动扫描。

say.text: 扫描代码库，找出值得深化的模块并出份HTML报告。
看看最近改动多的代码区域，有哪些架构摩擦点？
say.note: 它会检查提交历史来找热点。

say.text: 帮我分析这个子系统的浅层问题，列出候选重构方案。
say.note: 指定方向后会直接扫描该区域。

howto.what_en: Scans a codebase for 'shallow' modules to deepen for testability and AI-navigability, produces a visual HTML report with before/after diagrams, then works through the chosen candidate with you, updating domain notes as you go.
howto.when_en: When you ask to analyze/improve codebase architecture or find refactoring opportunities, or name a module/subsystem/pain point, Claude starts this scan.

say_en.text: Scan the codebase, find modules worth deepening, and produce an HTML report.
say_en.note: It explores first, then generates the report.

say_en.text: Which recently changed areas have the most architecture friction?
say_en.note: It checks commit history to find hot spots.

say_en.text: Help me analyze this subsystem's shallow spots and list refactor options.
say_en.note: It scans that area directly once you point at it.
